desc:
One Piece: Legacy

The game is an Opl remake.

Welcome to a challenging One Piece adventure. I highly recommend looking forward to exciting features not found in other One Piece games, such as eating two Devil Fruits and becoming a legend

Current fruits in the game:
Common: Spin, Luck , Clear, Chop, Clone, Float, Hot, Swim, Spring, Slip
Uncommon: Barrier, Love, Smelt, Order, Diamond, Bomb, Hobby,String,More
Rare: Candy, Chilly, Flare, Sand,Plasma,Gravity, Gas, Gum,Sand,Snow,Smoke,Door
Epic: Magma,Light,Ope,Rumble,Kage
Ultra Rare: Dark, Quake, Phoenix, Vampire, Alice

Developers:
lazmuri3

Game Map and Concept Designer:
Oblivic (One Piece Legendary Owner)
